description: This file defines the Online controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard extension, handling display and save operations for online customer data.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for managing the online customers dashboard in Opencart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the online dashboard page with breadcrumbs, configuration options, and view rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the online dashboard settings, including permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns a view with the total number of online customers, formatted with units.
